title: The Graveyard Book
author: Neil Gaiman
short_summary: A toddler survives the murder of his family by a mysterious man named Jack and wanders into a nearby graveyard, where the ghosts who live there decide to raise him as one of their own. Renamed Nobody "Bod" Owens and protected by his enigmatic guardian Silas, Bod grows up learning ghostly skills like Fading and exploring the world both inside and beyond the graveyard's gates. As he grows older, Bod must eventually face the secret society of assassins responsible for his family's death.
extended_summary:
After a man named Jack murders his family in the night, a baby boy toddles out of his house and into a nearby graveyard, unknowingly saving his own life. The ghosts who live there, along with the mysterious guardian Silas, decide to take the child in, naming him Nobody Owens — Bod, for short — and granting him the Freedom of the Graveyard, which lets him see in the dark and interact with the dead. As Bod grows up surrounded by ghosts instead of living children, he learns unusual skills like Fading (becoming hard to notice) and Dreamwalking, while Silas quietly protects him from the dangerous world beyond the graveyard walls, including the man Jack, who is still searching for the child he failed to kill.

Over the years, Bod has adventures both within the graveyard and in the town beyond it, forming friendships with a living girl named Scarlett and learning more about his own unusual upbringing and the ghostly community that raised him. As he approaches adulthood, Bod finally learns the truth about his family's murder and the secret order of assassins called the Jacks of All Trades that Jack belongs to. Bod must summon everything the graveyard has taught him to confront this danger and protect the people, living and dead, that he loves — before ultimately growing up and leaving the graveyard to make his own way in the world of the living.
